description: This file defines the interface EntityDatatableChecksReadService, which declares methods for retrieving data table check templates and related data in the Fineract system.

classes.name: EntityDatatableChecksReadService
classes.description: Interface for reading data table check templates and checks related data.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the default data table checks template data.

methods.name: retrieveTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of data table check templates filtered by status, entity, and product ID.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of data checks based on search parameters, status, entity, and product ID.
